decision_type: Offer architecture diagnosis and pre-launch gate
question_or_problem: Determine whether the binding constraint is advertising, capacity, or offer/response conversion; define what must be fixed before spend
evidence_date_range: Historical account data 2026-01-01 to 2026-09-30; setup last inspected 2026-10-02; inbox sample 2026-09-03 to 2026-10-02; owner facts 2026-10-03
evidence_summary: Cheap traffic (PHP 24.11-43.07 per conversation; ~103 conversations/month) plus spare owner-stated capacity (3-5 jobs/day) indicates the constraint is post-inquiry conversion, not traffic or capacity. Current offer uses 'starts at PHP 3,000 depending on location', bundles three services vaguely, creates no urgency, and conflicts with PHP 3,500 in historical ads and inbox replies. Inbox evidence shows unanswered inquiries (C10), AI-confirmed appointments customers waited for (C08, C04), and repair questions answered with generic price paragraphs (C09). AI failed a synthetic test by offering a callback and promising immediate contact to a text-only customer.
options_considered: Continue optimising the ad account; build tracking/website first; test video; scale spend; restructure the offer and gate the launch
recommendation: PROPOSED: (1) Replace the vague offer with three concrete priced offers - route day PHP 3,000, standard PHP 3,800 Davao City proper (+PHP 500 outside), institutional first piano PHP 3,500 / additional PHP 2,000 same visit / annual PHP 6,000 per piano. (2) Remove 'starts at' and the bundled 'minor repairs' promise from all advertising and AI knowledge. (3) Clear a three-item pre-launch gate before any spend: human visibility of unanswered messages; AI prohibited from promising contact or callbacks; one reconciled price everywhere. (4) Do not touch video, pixel/website, interest targeting, scaling, or GenSan.
reason_or_hypothesis: Traffic is already cheap and capacity is spare, so the marginal peso is lost in the conversation, not the auction. A price that is true beats a price that is low; a discount tied to a route day buys scheduling control and collapses travel cost rather than buying volume.
expected_signal_and_review_date: Owner decision on the three prices, especially the PHP 3,800 standard floor. Then re-test the AI on the 'customer waited' and text-only scenarios before any spend. First qualified-inquiry and completed-job tally determines whether to scale.
risks_or_guardrails: All prices are proposals, not confirmed facts, and no price may appear in ads, AI knowledge or customer replies without explicit owner approval. Conversation-to-job rate and unit margin remain unknown and were not re-requested per owner instruction. No live change authorized; DEC-006 Davao-only scope still applies.
confidence: High confidence that traffic and capacity are not the primary constraint; moderate confidence that offer and response handling are; low confidence in any specific conversion-rate or margin estimate
